name: pagemods
description: Pluggable page mods: fill forms from URL and field rules, auto-reload a tab, and more, from a settings panel that opens inside the page.

toggle-panel.description: Toggle the pagemods panel (the in-page shortcut, Ctrl+; by default, is configured in the panel)

formfill-fill.description: Fill the forms on this page from the matching rules

formfill-capture.description: Capture what is typed into the forms on this page into a rule

autoreload-toggle.description: Start or stop auto-reload for this tab
